findings.key_quote: The increases in average price per ad in the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 were driven by an increase in advertising demand, which we believe is mostly due to ongoing improvements to our ad performance from our ad targeting and measurement tools.
findings.justification: This passage explicitly states that for the three months ended September 30, 2026 (matching the claim period), the increase in average price per ad was driven by an increase in advertising demand, which Meta believes is mostly due to ongoing improvements to ad performance from their ad targeting and measurement tools. This directly establishes that AI investments (which power these ad targeting and measurement tools) are improving advertising performance in the specified quarter.

findings.key_quote: Average price per ad in the third quarter of 2026 increased by 14% year-over-year.
findings.justification: This evidence shows that average price per ad increased 14% year-over-year for Q3 2026, which is consistent with improved advertising performance. However, it does not establish causation from AI investments - it only provides the level of change without stating what caused it.

findings.key_quote: we are making significant investments in artificial intelligence (AI), including generative AI, to improve our delivery, targeting, and measurement capabilities.
findings.justification: This passage describes Meta's strategy and ongoing investments in AI to improve advertising capabilities, but it does not state what results were achieved in Q3 2026. It describes management intent and actions, not observed results for the specific quarter.

findings.key_quote: The increases in average price per ad in the three and six months ended June 30, 2026 were driven by an increase in advertising demand, which we believe is mostly due to ongoing improvements to our ad performance from our ad targeting and measurement tools
findings.justification: This evidence is for Q2 2026 (three months ended June 30, 2026), not Q3 2026 (the claim period). While it shows a similar causal relationship in an earlier period, it does not decide the claim about Q3 2026 results.

findings.key_quote: we are making significant investments in artificial intelligence (AI), including generative AI, to improve our delivery, targeting, and measurement capabilities.
findings.justification: This is from the Q2 2026 10-Q and describes ongoing investments and strategy, not results achieved in Q3 2026. It is management intent, not observed results for the claim period.

findings.key_quote: In the nine months ended September 30, 2026, 89% of our total costs and expenses were recognized in FoA and 11% were recognized in RL. Our FoA investments include expenses relating to headcount, data centers, and technical infrastructure as part of our efforts to develop our apps and our advertising services. These efforts include significant investments in AI initiatives
findings.justification: This evidence describes the allocation of costs and investments in AI for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 (not the three months), and describes what Meta is investing in rather than what results were achieved. It does not establish that AI investments improved advertising performance in Q3 2026.
